name: Fieldbook
desc: Your Creaturepedia. Waterproof-ish, and already full of coffee stains.

name: Map
desc: A proper paper map. You'll still get lost, but with confidence.

name: Cycle Voucher
desc: Good for one free loan bike. Bev insists the brakes mostly work.

name: Bike
desc: Two wheels, one bell, and a chain that squeaks in a friendly way. Faster than walking, slower than you'd like.

name: Rail Pass
desc: Unlimited trains, subject to the replacement bus service that nobody warned you about.

name: Ferry Ticket
desc: One passage on the Holyhead ferry, handed over with a wink and a warning about the Irish Sea.

name: Lantern
desc: A brass hurricane lamp that has seen several storms and is rather proud of it. Lights the dark bits the map politely ignores.

name: Waders
desc: Chest-high rubber waders that smell faintly of peat and regret, which is exactly what the bog wants from you.

name: Moot Token
desc: A carved oak token from the Moot. It gets you through the gates, and then it gets you into the arguments.

name: Brodgar Pebble
desc: A smooth grey pebble from the Ring of Brodgar, warm at night. It does nothing at all, which is rather the point of a keepsake.

name: Fairy Bridge Ribbon
desc: A finger-length of green ribbon from the little folk of the Isle of Man. Say hello when you cross a bridge, and it might say hello back.

name: Fieldbook Diploma
desc: Awarded by Professor Garside for a complete Fieldbook. Stamped with a potato, signed with pride, and slightly damp.

name: Team Thermos
desc: A flask big enough for the whole team. While it's on, everyone in your party gets three quarters of the XP from each win, even the ones on the bench. Use it to switch it on or off.

name: Trader's Pannier
desc: A pair of stout wicker baskets for a pony or a patient friend. Without it you can carry thirty of any one thing to sell on; with it, the usual ninety-nine.

name: Rows Stair Key
desc: A small iron key tagged ROWS UP. The Chester clockmaker swears it only opens one door.
